messages:
sasha (PM): Need a short record of final GA readiness decisions so we can close the roadmap card. Items: SLA numbers, monitoring minimums, support rotation, docs gating, pricing stance.
ben (Eng): Runtime can meet p50~130ms, p95~360ms if we pin batching and enable KV caching. We need to document the default batching window in configs.
rachel (SRE): For SLA we should measure availability as % of successful requests (2xx + 3xx) vs total attempted. Define outages as sustained 5xx rate >0.5% over a 10m window. Suggest 99.9% availability monthly.
jamal (Docs): Docs ask: public quickstart + troubleshooting FAQ required at GA. Full internal runbook within 10 business days post-GA. Public FAQ will include token-cost worked examples.
neha (FinOps): Enterprise committed pricing requires billing path tests; otherwise mark public pricing as "estimates" and flag for legal. Billing E2E tests ~2 business days.
ci-bot: ci: canary deploy 5% traffic. Observability: no regressions so far.
sasha (PM): Proposed GA checklist for exec: SLA target: monthly availability 99.9%, p95 latency target per-route 400ms; Monitoring: p50/p95 latencies, token-cost per-model, per-route error rates, alerting rules: latency p95 spike, errors >0.5% 10m, cache-hit drop >20%; Support: SRE primary for first-response GA week, product on-call first 2 hours for incidents; Docs: public FAQ + quickstart required, internal runbook within 10 days; Pricing: public estimates; committed pricing via sales post-GA.
ben (Eng): +1 pending config PR locking batching. I'll open it now.
rachel (SRE): +1; I'll post exact outage wording and error-budget calc for legal to review.
jamal (Docs): +1; FAQ draft tonight.
neha (FinOps): +1 on estimates. I'll run billing tests Wed-Thu and post results.
sasha (PM): Thanks — I'll fold these into the GA one-pager and share with GTM. If the canary shows anomalies, raise here and we'll triage. :raised_hands:
